keyEvents.text: Goal! Pachuca 1, Tigres 0. Salomón Rondón (Pachuca) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Tigres. Ozziel Herrera replaces Diego Sánchez.
Goal! Pachuca 2, Tigres 0. Salomón Rondón (Pachuca) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Oussama Idrissi.
Substitution, Tigres. Rodrigo Aguirre replaces Guillermo Martínez.
Substitution, Tigres. Ricardo Monreal replaces Diego Lainez.
Delay in match (Pachuca).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Pachuca. Kenedy replaces Nicolás Vallejo.
Rafael Guerrero (Tigres) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Pachuca 3, Tigres 0. Kenedy (Pachuca) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Oussama Idrissi.
Substitution, Tigres. Vladimir Loroña replaces Jesús Garza.
Substitution, Tigres. César Araújo replaces Rafael Guerrero.
Substitution, Pachuca. Mauricio Isaís replaces Alán Bautista.
Substitution, Pachuca. Sebastián Santos replaces Jorge Berlanga.
Alan Franco (Tigres) is shown the red card.
Delay in match (Tigres).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Rodolfo Pizarro (Pachuca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Pachuca. Thomas Contreras replaces Oussama Idrissi.
Substitution, Pachuca. Cristóbal Hernández replaces Rodolfo Pizarro.
Sebastián Santos (Pachuca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Pachuca 3, Tigres 0.
